SCRIPT.KOREAN: 그럼, 두 분 그냥 친구 아니고 사귀던 사이...?
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: So… you two weren’t just friends? You were actually dating...?
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 所以两位不是普通朋友，而是交往过的关系…？
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 那…你們兩個不是普通朋友，是交往過的關係嗎…？
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: じゃあ、二人ってただの友達じゃなくて付き合ってた…？
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Jadi… kalian berdua tuh bukan cuma temenan doang? Kalian beneran pacaran…?
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Então... vocês dois não eram só amigos...?
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Entonces… ¿ustedes dos no eran solo amigos...?
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: پس... شما دو نفر فقط با هم دوست نبودید؟ راستی قرار بودی...؟

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Psh, no, it was totally fake! Just a cover!
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 哎呦那只是伪装啦，装的情侣！
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 哎呀，那只是假裝的啦，假的！
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: いやいや、あれはカモフラージュだって、カモフラージュ！
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Cih, nggak lah, itu bohongan doang! Cuma buat nutupin aja!
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Ah, não, era tudo fachada, pura mentira!
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Ay, no, era pura fachada, ¡todo falso!
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: پش، نه، کلا تقلبی بود! فقط یک جلد!

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 뭐 암튼 우리 별명이 미녀와 야수였어요~
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Still, people used to call us “Beauty and the Beast”~
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 总之我们当年的外号可是“美女与野兽”~
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 我們的綽號可是美女與野獸～
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: ま、とにかくうちらのあだ名は美女と野獣だったんですよ〜
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Tapi ya, dulu orang-orang manggil kita “Beauty and the Beast”~
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Mesmo que nos chamassem de “A Bela e a Fera”~
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Aunque nos llamaban “la Bella y la Bestia”~
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: با این حال، مردم ما را "زیبایی و هیولا" صدا می کردند

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 제가 밀크고에서 1대 얼짱으로 좀 유명했었거든요. 기억하지?
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: I was kinda famous back then—Milk High’s original top visual, remember?
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 我可是牛奶高中的第一届校花，你还记得吧？
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 我在 Milk 高中可是最有名的校花，你還記得吧？
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 私、ミルク高で初代の美人ってちょっと有名だったの 覚えてる？
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Aku tuh lumayan terkenal waktu itu—cewe cantik top pertama dari SMA Milk, inget nggak?
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Eu era considerada a mais bonita de todo o Ensino Médio Milk, lembra?
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Yo era considerada la más guapa de toda la Preparatoria Milk, ¿te acuerdas?
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: من در اون زمان تا حدودی مشهور بودم - تصویر اصلی شیر های، یادتان هست؟

SCRIPT.JAPANESE: ちょっと待って ミルク高って？
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: صبر کن - صبر کن! شیر زیاد؟!

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 왜요? 나 설마 다른 학교에서도 유명하고 그랬나??
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Why? Don’t tell me I was famous at other schools too?
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 怎么了？难道我在其他学校也很有名吗？？
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 怎麼了？難道說我在別的學校也很有名嗎？？
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: なんで？まさか他の学校でも有名だったとか？
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Kenapa? Jangan bilang aku juga terkenal di sekolah lain?
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Por quê? Será que também me conheciam em outras escolas??
SCRIPT.SPANISH: ¿Por qué? ¿Acaso también me conocían en otras escuelas??
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: چرا؟ به من نگویید که در مدارس دیگر هم مشهور بودم؟

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: No, it’s just… I went to Milk High too…
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 不是的…我也是牛奶高中…毕业的…
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 不，我也是…從 Milk 高中畢業的…
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: いや…私もミルク高、出身なんだけど…
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Bukan gitu… aku juga sekolah di SMA Milk…
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Não, é que... eu também estudei lá...
SCRIPT.SPANISH: No, es que… yo también estudié ahí...
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: نه، فقط… من هم به شیر های رفتم…

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Wait, you went to Milk High?
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 嗯？你说你是牛奶高中毕业的？
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 嗯？你說你也是從 Milk 高中畢業？
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Tunggu, kamu juga anak SMA Milk?
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: صبر کن، تو به شیر های رفتی؟
